title: Volunteer in the canteen
body: We need one volunteer every Friday to help with lunch orders. Shifts are 10:30am–1:30pm. Contact Imke on 0447 020 823 or just show up — training provided.

title: Join the P&C
body: Come to a meeting — first Monday of each month, 7pm in the staffroom (online option available). Membership is $1/year. No commitment needed to attend. Next meeting: Monday 4 May.

title: Help at events
body: We run a handful of events each year — Trivia Night, Mother's Day, Father's Day, School Disco, and more. Even an hour of help on the day makes a difference.

title: Make a donation
body: Every dollar goes directly to improving our school. The P&C funded $17,800 for playground upgrades and $1,400 in classroom resources in 2025. Contact holgate.pandc@gmail.com.

title: Sponsor a P&C event
body: Local businesses can sponsor our events — Trivia Night, School Disco, Father's Day, and more. We offer acknowledgment across our channels. Get in touch at holgate.pandc@gmail.com.
